feature: Canonical64x64 RGB crop, uint8, OpenCV RGB-to-gray; HOG window64x64, block32x32, stride16x16, cell16x16,9unsigned bins, gammaCorrection=false, L2Hys0.2.324features. No color threshold or learned image preprocessing.
grouping: Union every equal canonical source basename (Roboflow suffix removed) and every identical crop SHA256, including augmented/repeated rows. Assign connected source groups by SHA256 of sorted aliases modulo5. This is source-grouped TRAIN cross-validation, not recording-session-independent qualification.
fit: Each fold fits only other groups. Foreground combines red and blue. Inverse class-frequency weights give foreground/background equal total weight. Fit weighted feature mean/std, then weighted ridge with unpenalized intercept0.5 after centering. No penalty or feature-size sweep. Threshold is minimum fitted-positive score so fitting positives are not rejected. Keep equality.
gate: Only veto already-accepted blue predictions when shape score<threshold. Red predictions and geometry unchanged. Compare with frozen parent probabilities. Fit and calibration never use withheld fold rows or IMG data. Report every lost previously accepted true crop.
progress_gate: At least one out-of-fold blue false positive rejected; blue F1 must improve and neither color's minimum(precision,recall) may decrease. This gate allows full-scene research evaluation only, not deployment. The final objective remains at least94%precision AND recall per color on independent real scenes and separate live qualification.
scope: TRAIN-only first-stage feasibility. Source-held-out error tradeoffs explicit. No Pi timing or deployment claim from desktop feature extraction or crop metrics.
